slowReviewBudgetRecommendation.note: These are conservative viewing limits to reduce load and respect platform friction, not timing randomization or anti-detection behavior.

candidateCaptureFields: post URL and stable content ID
author, visible publish date and collection timestamp
visible title and directly relevant caption text
media count, inspected media indices and original order
frame or image observations separated from author claims
east-end continuity decision and rejection reason when not qualified
source media fingerprint only after an authorized read-only download

acceptanceMatrix.pass: One unbroken video segment or an ordered same-post image sequence visibly connects the inner east lane, the exit threshold and the outside road without a montage or location jump.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: A single facade, isolated road view, unproven before/after pair or images from different posts.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: The endpoint shows a readable Panyu Road sign/address, or at least two unique visible landmarks that independently match current map geometry and establish Panyu Road.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Caption-only Panyu claim, generic asphalt road, photographer uncertainty, or map proximity without visible scene correspondence.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: The same chain clearly shows lane paving, sidewalk or verge, curb transition and asphalt edge at the east exit from a usable oblique or cross-road angle.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Road centerline only, fully occluded edge, night glare, or crop that hides the lane-to-road transition.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: The south-side entrance building is visible in the same continuous chain and its relationship to the exit threshold can be followed.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: An unidentified building outside the entrance context or a facade that cannot be connected to the endpoint.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: The entrance matrix wall or equivalent gridded boundary is visible with both its lane-side end and road-side end, allowing its extent to be compared with the curb.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: A generic fence, a close-up without endpoints, or an inferred wall behind vegetation.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: The lane base or hardscape edge is visible continuously to its termination at the entrance and can be distinguished from sidewalk and asphalt.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Material texture alone, an interior-only paving view, or an assumed rectangular base.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: At least two existing East cues, such as white glass corner, timber grille, brick vertical stack or storefront rhythm, co-occur with the exit evidence.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Only generic Shanghai lane cues or no correspondence with the accepted East subject.

acceptanceMatrix.pass: Publish or capture date is recorded; visible temporary barriers, construction, tenant signs and later alterations are separated from stable geometry.
acceptanceMatrix.reject: Undated media treated as current surveyed truth.

readOnlyArchiveContract.rawMediaPolicy: Preserve original bytes, filenames, order, SHA-256 and metadata read-only; new analysis uses separate derived files and never overwrites source media.
readOnlyArchiveContract.wikiPolicy: Hard-link only the Markdown source into the Wiki raw-source tree; do not hard-link or copy binary media into Wiki sources.
readOnlyArchiveContract.completionPolicy: Archive plus rescan is not completion; require queue clear, search hit, read-back and traceability to source media.
